instruction: I need you to copy the ID number from Cell H25 in the LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet and perform a Google search for it in Chrome.

metadata.explanation: Task asks to copy cell H25 (ID column, row 25) from the spreadsheet and search it in Chrome. Verified from Excel file: Row 25, Column H contains '6574.0' (ID number). Evaluator checks if active tab URL matches Google search for '6574'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if correct Google search performed, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab URL using get_active_tab_info which reads from accessibility tree and navigates to get full tab information
Metric logic correctly uses is_expected_search_query to match the active tab URL against the expected Google search pattern using regex
Expected value '6574' is verified from metadata as the actual ID value in cell H25 of the spreadsheet
Evaluator correctly checks both implicit requirement (ID value must be copied and used) and explicit requirement (Google search must be performed)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts URL -> metric checks if URL matches Google search for '6574' -> returns binary score
No postconfig needed as search result page should remain accessible after task completion
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Regex pattern '(?i)https?://(?:www\.)?google\.com/search\?q=6574(?:&|$|#).*' uses (?:&|$|#) which requires 6574 to be followed by &, end-of-string, or #. While this works for standard Google searches, it might not match if Google adds other characters in the same parameter value (unlikely but possible). Could be relaxed to '(?i)https?://(?:www\.)?google\.com/search\?.*q=6574.*' for more robustness, but current pattern is acceptable for this use case.
